messages:
Mel (oncall): paging SREs — GPUs spiking, autoscaler not responding. infer-queue-prod length jumping, customers seeing errors. Investigating now.

incident-bot: Incident created: HIGH - GPU capacity exhaustion in prod. Pager: Mel. Runbook: https://redwood/ops/incidents/1234

Ron (SRE): looking. First check: is HPA receiving custom metrics? run: `kubectl get hpa -n prod infer-deployment -o yaml | grep metrics -A2`

Anya (MLOps): I'm seeing Prometheus scrape backlog and adapter 504s. We rolled a relabel tweak yesterday — suspicious. metrics-adapter shows handler timeouts.

Paul (Infra): Cluster autoscaler logs show nodes not provisioning — cloud GPU quota at ~98% in us-west-2. If we hit quota CA can't add nodes. Filing cloud support.

Kai (Runtime): Traffic profile: token ingress stable but queue latency 2.3x normal. Runtime returning throttling/502 on some requests. Snippet: ```
2026-03-15T03:12:02Z infer: request queued (len=312)
2026-03-15T03:12:45Z runtime: serve error: model-unavailable -> fallback
```

Lina (Support): multiple customers reporting 5xxs, ticket #7892. Onboarding pipelines failing. Need ETA for mitigation.

Olga (PM): please confirm regions affected — EU too? Customers asking for timeline.

Mel (oncall): immediate mitigation plan ideas: manual scale-up, route degrade to CPU fallback for low-tier traffic, restart metrics components. Ron can you attempt a manual scale while we investigate metrics?

Ron (SRE): issuing manual scale now: `kubectl patch deployment infer-deployment -n prod -p '{"spec":{"replicas":15}}'` — pods are spinning but many Pending due to GPU shortage. Some pods falling back to CPU. HPA might fight the change.

incident-bot: Alert: metrics-server restarted 3x in last 10m, restartCount high.

Anya (MLOps): tailing metrics-adapter: ```time=\"2026-03-15T03:14:17Z\" level=error msg=\"handler timeout\" path=\"/v1/namespaces/prod/custom.metrics.k8s.io\"``` — adapter timeouts explaining HPA silence.

Paul (Infra): opened cloud quota ticket INC-4532, requested emergency GPU quota bump. ETA uncertain ~30-60m. Also bumping metrics-server memory.

Kai (Runtime): flipping degrade route for non-enterprise customers — route policy to send 60% to CPU-fallback. Doing now. This should reduce GPU pressure and edge 429s.

Mel (oncall): plan: 1) enable degrade route for non-enterprise (Kai) 2) manual scale until HPA healthy (Ron) 3) restart metrics-adapter + metrics-server (Anya/Paul) 4) customer status update (Lina/Olga) — execute.

Ron (SRE): manual scale applied; seeing pods Pending. Some pods scheduled on CPU nodes (fallback) — verifying traffic shift.

Kai (Runtime): degrade route enabled. Observed ~30% reduction in 5xx rate on edge within 3m. :thumbsup:

Anya (MLOps): restarting metrics-adapter: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metrics-adapter -n kube-system` — adapter logs show backlog draining, endpoints responding again.

Paul (Infra): restarted metrics-server and increased mem to 1.5Gi — OOMs stopped. metrics-server now reporting node metrics.

incident-bot: Reminder: tag incident severity and capture timeline in incident doc.

Mel (oncall): HPA started receiving external metrics again but there is lag. Queue length trending down from ~320 to ~120 over 10m. Error rate dropped from ~12% -> ~5%.

Lina (Support): updated ticket #7892 and sent an interim status to affected customers: "degraded performance, mitigations applied, ongoing monitoring".

Olga (PM): what follow-ups? We need a plan for quota and to revert the relabel change if it's the culprit.

Anya (MLOps): hypothesis: Prom relabel change increased scrape cardinality -> metrics-adapter timeouts under load -> metrics-server OOM -> HPA starvation -> no scale-up -> queue growth -> throttling. Will produce evidence.

Ron (SRE): immediate action items: rollback prometheus relabel tweak (Anya), add adapter circuit-breaker and metrics freshness alarms (Kai), request GPU quota buffer (Paul), add HPA metric freshness canary (Mel). I'll own RCA doc.

Mel (oncall): handing off to Ron for post-incident work. Ron, you're lead for RCA and follow-ups.

Ron (SRE): taking lead — creating incident doc now and assigning owners. Will ping for updates.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated — system degradation reduced to acceptable levels. Severity: SEV2. Monitoring for 30m.

Kai (Runtime): left notes in the runtime runbook about model-degrade route and how to trigger it for similar incidents.

Mel (oncall): thanks team, I'll monitor for 30m then mark resolved if stable.

Lina (Support): customers notified. Will close tickets once stable.

Olga (PM): thanks all. Please include timeline and evidence linking relabel change in the RCA.

End of thread.
